summary: Real Brokerage Inc. (REAX) filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire RE/MAX Holdings (RMAX). The deal implies an enterprise value of ~$880M for RE/MAX, representing a 7x fully synergized multiple on 2025 EBITDA. The combined entity, Real REMAX Group, would have generated ~$2.3B in revenue and $157M in Adjusted EBITDA pre-synergies in 2025. The transaction is expected to be accretive to Real's earnings and EBITDA margin within the first full year post-close. Real's CEO and RE/MAX's CEO both endorsed the deal. Investors should watch for regulatory approvals and integration execution as key closing conditions.
